specification.objective: Polish the now-functional Kanban page for lower visual weight and clearer hierarchy: remove redundant project context from the task editor, replace oversized project statistic cards with a compact shared metrics strip, and reduce board chrome duplication while preserving the working responsive layout, drag behavior, persistence, and dependency surface.

requirements.statement: Task creation and editing must no longer render a redundant current-project context block inside the shared task editor.
The project overview must keep project selection, refresh, column/card/team counts, and responsive behavior while replacing the three oversized statistic tiles with one compact metrics strip.
The Kanban board header must reduce technical and duplicated chrome by hiding the internal board version from users and retaining only meaningful sync/navigation/create-column controls.
Lane headers must avoid duplicate card-creation affordances; the persistent 'Adicionar card' footer remains the discoverable primary create-card action.
The top navigation, board spacing, guidance copy, status controls, and empty-state density must be tightened without changing the established square TouchIn visual language.
No backend, API, controller, persistence, raw-pointer drag mechanism, dependency, global theme, or shared WorkspaceEditorDialog contract may change.

acceptance_criteria.statement: ProjectTaskEditorDialog no longer requires ProjectSummary, contains no _ProjectContext widget, and the project-management task-editor test asserts that 'Projeto atual' is absent.

The project overview renders one kanban-project-metrics strip exactly 48 logical pixels high and desktop coverage bounds kanban-project-overview below 80 logical pixels while preserving the selector and refresh control.
The visible board header keeps 'Sincronizado'/'Salvando' but no longer renders a vN technical version chip.
Lane headers no longer render a second add-task icon; 'Adicionar card' remains available in each manageable lane footer.
The accent top bar is reduced to 54 logical pixels, board header spacing/control sizing is tightened, and responsive page/card bounds from the prior increment remain protected.
pubspec, AppTheme, WorkspaceEditorDialog, ProjectKanbanController, backend, contracts, network APIs, and raw-pointer drag functions remain unchanged.

invariants.statement: Card move/drop resolution, stable IDs, server-authoritative mutation flow, conflict handling, and scroll-controller ownership remain unchanged.
Task field limits, type selection, parent-task selection, TaskDraft output, and the shared square editor shell remain unchanged.
The board status indicator remains inside the board section and the navbar does not reintroduce a duplicate sync-status block.
320x568, 390x844, tablet, and desktop layouts remain finite without external dependencies or intrinsic-size workarounds.

forbidden_states.statement: A package dependency, renderer workaround, alternate drag framework, or global theme override is introduced for cosmetic polish.
Removing project context from the task modal removes task validation, type, parent relation, or edit semantics.
Statistics remain three large standalone cards that dominate the project strip.
Card creation becomes undiscoverable after removing the duplicate lane-header add icon.

inputs.statement: User screenshot shows the current functional Kanban with a visually heavy project statistic row, redundant project context in task editing, and duplicated board/lane controls.
The prior increments established a reusable WorkspaceEditorDialog, compact 144px cards, responsive board constraints, and a functional raw-pointer Kanban implementation that must remain protected.

outputs.statement: A slimmer project context toolbar with one compact metrics strip.
A task editor focused only on task data, without redundant project context.
A lighter board/lane action hierarchy with less technical and duplicate chrome.

failure_semantics.statement: With only the focused regression test changes installed on the baseline, the regression command exits 1 and prints kanban_ui_density_polish_missing.
Any Flutter compile, overflow, or layout failure after application is authoritative and must be corrected without changing protected Kanban/domain behavior.
